meta.description: Imports the lab's scans for a roll: the download link arrives by mail, the CLI uploads the files into PocketBase, the roll moves to 'developed' and a summary comes back by mail. A second, scheduled branch only reports what the lab says about an open order. See docs/automation.md.

nodes.name: Lab mail arrives
nodes.notes: The lab mail. Narrow the FROM filter once you have seen the real sender.

nodes.name: PocketBase: log in
nodes.notes: Same three variables the CLI uses; set them in n8n's environment, not in the workflow.

nodes.name: PocketBase: roll for this order

parameters.name: filter
parameters.value: ={{ `labOrderId = "${$('Extract order and download link').first().json.orderId}" && deleted = null` }}

nodes.notes: The order number is a field on the roll (Roll.labOrderId) - that is how the workflow knows which roll the files belong to.

nodes.name: Exactly one roll?
nodes.notes: Zero means the order number is not on any roll yet; two means it is on two - both need a human, so the false branch only mails.

nodes.name: Run filmnotes-import

parameters.command: =cd {{ $env.FILMNOTES_REPO }} && npm run --silent import -w @filmnotes/scan-import -- --roll {{ $json.items[0].id }} --json --yes '{{ $('Extract order and download link').first().json.downloadUrl }}'

nodes.notes: The same CLI a person runs by hand: it downloads the link, plans the file-to-frame mapping, uploads, and prints one line of JSON. Replace with an SSH node if n8n does not run on the machine that holds the checkout.

nodes.name: PocketBase: roll is developed
nodes.notes: Only when something was uploaded - see the IF in front of it. clientUpdated is what the app's last-write-wins sync compares.

parameters.subject: =filmnotes: {{ $json.uploaded }} Scans für Auftrag {{ $json.orderId }}
=filmnotes: Scans da, aber kein passender Film

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.value: ={{ $('PocketBase: log in for the status check').first().json.token }}

nodes.name: PocketBase: log in for the status check
Lab: order info
nodes.notes: FILMNOTES_LAB_STATUS_URL carries the shop-specific part, e.g. https://spot.photoprintit.com/spotapi/orderInfo/forShop?config=<config>&shop=<shop>&order={order}

nodes.name: Mail: order status

parameters.subject: =filmnotes: Auftrag {{ $json.orderId }} ist {{ $json.finished ? 'fertig' : 'noch unterwegs' }}

nodes.notes: Only a heads-up. The import hangs off the mail trigger, because that is where the download link is.

main.node: PocketBase: log in for the status check
